proposition: The Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam was read to Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī by Shams al-Dīn Muḥammad al-Māzyār in Herat on 30 Rajab 820 (12 September 1417), per the colophon; the entry does not say whether Ibn Turka was present.
